@graph.definition: Offshore acreage released by the various Australian Government-State/NT Joint Authorities.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: A generic term for any hole or shaft drilled into the Earth. A borehole may have many purposes (eg, petroleum, mineral, or groundwater exploration or production; stratigraphic or engineering investigation).
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Country name (ISO 3166-1998 Code for the representation of names of countries)
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data about CO2 Emission sources - including power stations, petroleum fields, gas processing plants, oil refineries, coke production plants
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data about ESSCIs - environmentally sustainable sites for CO2 injection
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data about Australian estuaries
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Permit to provide exclusive rights to undertake seismic surveys and drilling in a defined area.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains information about facies - derived from within Australian estuaries
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Place (site) where an observation and/or measurement was made and/or sampling took place. For example observations/measurements/samples of rocks, soil, stream sediments, water, regolith, landform, vegetation, or rock properties.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: A facility that provides controlled conditions in which scientific or technological research, experiments, and measurement may be performed.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: A MAPSHEET is the bounding polygon of the map as in, for example, the National Mapping 1:250 000 map sheet index. Mapsheets can be any scale, and include standard mapsheet boundaries and non-standard mapsheet boundaries.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This table contains information on data subsets of a survey, referred to as segments. Operations segments are defined by a substantial change in the recording parameters of a survey, loop segments are defined where the survey loops on itself, and sampling segments identify where the ship may have stopped or slowed for sampling.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Locality of mining or processing plant waste, such as tailings dam, slag heap, or dumps
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: An aggregation of mineralisation that may or may not have resources defined
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: A mineral accumulation in the lithosphere.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: A mining operation or mineral exploration project that includes multiple mineral deposits
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: A mineralised zone may describe a zone of uneconomic mineralisation or an economic orebody. There may be one or more mineralised zone within a specific Mineral Deposit entity.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: a generic term for any CPC/PALEO and mineral specimen museum collection.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data about observatories - buildings or places set apart for, and furnished with instruments for making, observations of natural phenomena; esp., for magnetic observations, ,astronomical, meteorological
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data for reprocessing activities carried out under the Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Act.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data about pipelines - containers joining two connection points for the transportation of oil, gas, water or other materials
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data about Gazetteer place names
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data about political regions and boundaries.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Harbour - a place by the sea, or by a river or other waterway,where ships and boats can dock, load, and unload.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Site where fossil fuel, nuclear, hydro, solar, wind, biological or other resources are converted into electrical power.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Licence granted to holder of exploration permit or retention lease, for the recovery of petroleum following a commercial discovery.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data about projects
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data about provinces
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Locality for adding value to raw materials, particularly minerals.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Proposed, planned or developing scheme, including infrastructure, for extracting resources that requires a large amount of time, effort, capital, or planning. Once developed, the type of entity could change to MINE, WELL, RESOURCE PROCESSING PLANT, or something similar.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Lease granted to holder of exploration permit, where a discovery is not currently commercial but is expected to become so.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: A set of observations and/or measurements and/or samples taken at points or intervals along a line, section or traverse, in any direction at or beneath the earth's surface (measured section). For example, observations of a group of stratigraphic units or regolith zones.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Information about seismic lines for a given survey.  Each seismic line has a different name, but the parameters of seismic lines in any given segment should be similar.  A segment may consist of many lines, and a line may fall within more than 1 segment if the operating parameters change.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: All States and Territories (currently only Australian implemented)
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: The physical points that outline a section or a point that indicates an area that displays the defining characteristics of a stratigraphic unit
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains data for marine, gravity, seismic and airborne surveys.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: This entity contains general and header information about wells.  A well is an actual or proposed hole in the ground, designed to exchange fluids between a subsurface reservoir and the surface (or another reservoir) or to retrieve rock core or samples or to enable the detection and measurement of rock properties.  A well (eg sidetrack or horizontal well) may originate from another well defined by PARENT.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type

@graph.definition: Permit to conduct further exploration and/or appraisal activities within the location blocks to determine more accurately the nature of the discovery.
@graph.schemeLabel: General Geology - Entity or Feature Type
